 How to Download RRB ALP Admit Card 2026?
 Candidates should follow the instructions provided for downloading the ALP hall ticket for the exam. 
 Visit the official regional RRB website.
 Find the RRB ALP Admit Card 2026 download link.
 Click on the CBT 1 Admit Card link.
 Enter your Registration Number and Password/Date of Birth as requested.
 Submit the login details on the website. 
 Your RRB ALP Hall Ticket 2026 will appear on the screen.
 Download and print the admit card for the examination day.

 Documents Required Along with RRB ALP Admit Card
 Keep a checklist of the documents required on the RRB ALP exam day. 
 Printed copy of RRB ALP Admit Card 2026.
 Original valid photo identity proof (as permitted in the official instructions).
 Recent passport-size photograph, if required by the RRB instructions.
 Any additional document specifically mentioned on the hall ticket.
 RRB ALP CBT 1 Exam Day Guidelines 2026
 RRB has provided some guidelines all candidates should follow for the CBT 1 exam. Carry all the relevant documents, including the ALP CBT 1 admit card, ID proof, and photograph, carefully to complete the verification process. 
 Reach the examination centre before the reporting time.
 Carry a printed admit card.
 Carry valid original photo ID proof.
 Follow the instructions mentioned on the hall ticket.
 Avoid carrying prohibited electronic devices.
 Follow frisking and verification procedures.
 Do not leave the examination hall without permission.
 Important Instructions For Candidates 
 Candidates should follow the ALP exam day instructions to reach the exam hall on time for the exam. 
 Check the spelling of your name and other personal details.
 Verify the exam date, shift and centre address.
 Check the reporting time and gate-closing time.
 Download the admit card before the examination.
 Keep multiple printed copies for safety.
 Contact the regional RRB for discrepancies or login-related issues.
